site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the NCG Guidelines for Head and Neck Cancer (2019) (National Cancer Grid, India), the shared oropharynx, hypopharynx and larynx work-up (p 10 and 11), the larynx pathways (p 14 to 20, 27 and 36) and the pathology format (p 56), each with its verbatim quote and page. NCG prints letters only for the imaging, the chest X-ray and the speech and swallowing assessment; the other work-up lines have no letter and are treated as Essential, as in the oral cavity checklist: the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' or 'treated as Essential' are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (a stage, a risk of distant disease) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. HPV / p16 testing (p 11) is for the oropharynx only and is not listed. The pathway is shared with the oropharynx and hypopharynx; hypopharynx is named in the site words and not built as a separate checklist. The stage is as recorded by the clinician, never computed. Nothing here suggests treatment.
settings_note: Setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage). The three settings follow the book's pathways: early disease (T1 to T2, N0, p 14), locally advanced disease (T1 to T2 with nodes, T3, T4 or inoperable neck nodes, p 15 to 20 and 27) and recurrent or metastatic disease (p 36).
